translations.web: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
translations.bsb: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
translations.kjv: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
translations.asv: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding he established the heavens.
